host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the RPC service for internal communication.

port.description: Port number to listen on for internal RPC traffic.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling RPC requests.

thread_pool_size.description: Size of the thread pool used for async I/O and background tasks.

transport_url.description: Message bus connection URL for RabbitMQ (or other supported backends).

database_connection.description: Database connection string (e.g., PostgreSQL or MySQL).

central_endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint of designate-central for RPC-style communication.

periodic_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between polls for pending DNS zone or recordset tasks.

max_tasks_per_run.description: Maximum number of tasks to process per polling cycle.

enable_zone_transfer_requests.description: Whether to process incoming DNS zone transfer (AXFR/IXFR) requests.

enable_recordset_updates.description: Whether to process dynamic DNS updates (RFC 2136) for recordsets.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file. Use empty string to log only to stderr.

log_level.description: Verbosity level of logging. Common values: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.
